title: Lenses, Visible Light and Black Body Radiation

flashcard_questions.q: A curved piece of transparent material (usually glass or plastic) that refracts light to form an image.
The point where parallel rays of light converge (convex) or appear to diverge from (concave) after passing through a lens.
The distance between the centre of a lens and its principal focus.

flashcard_questions.a: A lens that is thickest at the centre and refracts parallel rays of light inwards so they meet at the principal focus — also called a converging lens.
An image formed where light rays actually converge — it can be projected onto a screen.
